name: Omfurn India Ltd.
summary: Omfurn India Ltd. manufactures and supplies modular furniture and pre-finished wooden doors. The company offers a range of products including office, hotel, and school furniture, as well as modular kitchens, wardrobes, and vanities. It also provides pre-finished wooden doors, door frames, and fire-resistant doors. Omfurn India Ltd. specializes in turnkey interior projects, offering integrated services from design to installation. The company primarily caters to commercial offices, residential projects, the hospitality sector, educational institutions, and real estate developers in India, with some international presence. It operates within the furniture and related product manufacturing industry.
